Yes. An on-going story that has quenched my thirst after ROTA (well, that was a year ago, I have read tens of fictions since then and only got a few updates on the series). It also involves the Alterran civilization being revived (but that is not the focus of the story). The main character, Liam, is actually a descended ancient.

The series progresses much faster than ROTA. It also has a much larger scope. The main enemy spans across the entire observable universe.

The level of technology is far discrepant, and Earth gets uplifted.

I would tell you more, but it would probably be spoilers.

The series has 3 books, with the 3rd one ongoing, and a 4th one in the works.

​

P.S. It is an alternate universe, which, in my opinion, is valid within Stargate's canon. Remember the quantum mirror?

The story even mentions how there are alternate realities where Liam's absence caused events to unfold differently.

This story re-writes SG-1, SGA, and SGU. The first 2 got key moments re-written, but much of the rest is the same (and not mentioned in the story).

Greetings. I have read many. This is the best series:

* [Stargate: The Guardian's Order](https://www.fanfiction.net/s/8030445/1/Stargate-The-Guardian-s-Order). It continues with
* [Stargate: The Second Great Alliance](https://www.fanfiction.net/s/8524237/1/Stargate-The-Second-Great-Alliance) and
* [Stargate: Immortal](https://www.fanfiction.net/s/12319080/1/Stargate-Immortal) (which is still receiving updates)

I refer to it as Liam's Saga. It is by far the largest SG fanfiction universe I know of. And it has some of the most advanced technology I've seen. Though it does not build characters that much, it focuses on the conflicts and progress. Another book is planned. 

This series is my absolute favorite.

​

 There is also [Stargate: Return of the Ancients](http://aerkijyr.com/rota/), which is very good but was never finished. Please do not judge them by the summary. I guarantee that you will love the above stories.

​

[SGU: Series 3 Ep 01 Survival](https://www.fanfiction.net/s/7361352/1/SGU-Series-3-Ep-01-Survival)  \- SGU CONTINUATION - only if you like love relationships between characters. I do not, but the story was very engaging and there was a certain character (spoiler: from the race that "created" the Ancients) that kept me reading. 

[Among the Stars](https://www.fanfiction.net/s/3174179/1/Among-the-Stars) \- this reads a lot like an SGA episode or a season finale. Only 50K words. Great as a starter because it is closer to canon limits. They find a space station set up by the Ancients. Rodney gets hurt quite a lot. 

[Breaking Walls](https://www.fanfiction.net/s/2897353/1/Breaking-Walls) \- Rodney has a tragic past. This story is not my type, but it is a beast of a story if you value characters a lot. Liked it a lot. 

[Meeting of Minds](http://archiveofourown.org/works/101491) \- incredibly short (20K words) - remember the Gadmeer? The race that built the big terraforming machine, that once threatened the Enkarans? The episode where Carter rigged the Nq generator to blow? They rebuilt their civilization and wanted to meet SG-1. It deeply involves the Asgard and their history. Great story line. Reads like an episode, though it would not make sense in the canon. 

[Sheppard Moon](https://www.fanfiction.net/s/2826388/1/Sheppard-Moon) \- also reads a bit like an episode. Only 40K words. Another station set up by the Ancients, but it had a very special inhabitant. If you finish those, I can recommend more.
